title: Nowcasting of Tropical Cyclone Wind Fields and Intensity from Geostationary Imagery
abstract: arXiv:2611.08255v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: High-resolution tropical cyclone surface wind speeds derived from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) observations can support storm structure and intensity modelling, but remain spatially and temporally sparse and unavailable near-real-time. Geostationary satellites capture cloud tops continuously in space and time, but do not directly resolve surface winds. Here, we present simple neural networks to predict 2D wind fields and storm-scale intensity metrics from geostationary imagery. Through a series of ablation studies, we find that joint prediction of 2D fields and scalar metrics from the model latent space improves the retrieval of the (radius of) maximum wind, especially for rapid intensification events.

translated_title: 基于地球静止卫星图像的热带气旋风场与强度临近预报
translated_abstract: 由合成孔径雷达（SAR）观测获得的高分辨率热带气旋地表风速可以支持风暴结构与强度建模，但其在空间和时间上仍然稀疏，且无法近实时获取。地球静止卫星能够在空间和时间上连续观测云顶，但无法直接解析地表风。本文提出了简单的神经网络，可从地球静止卫星图像预测二维风场和风暴尺度强度指标。通过一系列消融实验，我们发现从模型潜空间联合预测二维场和标量指标能够改善最大风速（及其半径）的估计效果，尤其是在快速增强事件中。
tldr: 本文提出基于地球静止卫星图像的简单神经网络，通过在模型潜空间联合预测二维风场与风暴尺度强度指标，显著改善了最大风速及其半径的估计效果，尤其适用于快速增强事件。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes simple neural networks to jointly predict 2D wind fields and storm-scale intensity metrics from geostationary imagery, where joint prediction from the latent space improves the retrieval of maximum wind speed and its radius, especially during rapid intensification events.
